content: गोमत् {%a.%} .²1 Rich in cows. .²2 Possessing or containing cattle. .²3 Mixed with milk. --{%n.%} Possession of cattle, property consisting in herds. .{@-ती@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a river falling into the Indus; गोमतीमव तिष्ठति <ls>Rv. 8. 24. 30</ls>. .²2 A place abounding in herds; यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु <ls>Rv. 4. 21. 4</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a Vedic मन्त्र to be repeated during expiation for killing cows; <ls>Hch. 1. 7</ls>.
